已知阶段窗口均值之和。包含采集、编码、解码、渲染、RTT/2及排队；不含应用响应: Sum of known stage means: capture, encode, decode, render, RTT/2 and queues. Excludes application response, composition and scanout; this is not measured end-to-end latency.
主机获取本帧桌面图像的时间。: Time the host takes to acquire this desktop frame.
主机编码调用耗时，可包含硬件队列等待。: Host encoder call time, which can include hardware queue waits.
客户端UI准备与渲染提交的CPU墙钟时间，可能包含驱动等待；不是GPU计时或扫描: Client UI preparation and render submission CPU wall time, which can include driver waits. This is not GPU timing or scanout latency.
RTT的一半，仅在往返对称时近似单程。RTT还可能包含应用调度、处理与队列等待。: Half the RTT; approximates one-way delay only on a symmetric path. RTT can also include application scheduling, processing and queue waits.
主机发送等待、客户端解码队列和画面邮箱等待的合计。未知阶段不按零计算。: Sum of host send waits, client decode queue and frame mailbox waits. Unknown stages are not counted as zero.
控制消息往返均值±标准差，最近32个样本。包含传输、排队和两端处理，不等于ICM: Control message round-trip mean ± standard deviation over the latest 32 samples. Includes transport, queues and processing on both ends; differs from ICMP ping.
修复前的原始RTP缺包率。乱序宽限期后仍未到达的包计入，即使随后由FEC或RTX: Original RTP packet loss before recovery. Packets still missing after the reordering grace period count even if FEC or RTX later recovers them. Reflects delivery seen by the receiver, not only physical link loss.
接收器超时后仍未恢复的RTP丢包率；FEC/重传成功会降低这个值。: RTP packets still missing after the receiver's recovery timeout. Successful FEC or retransmission reduces this value.
最近一分钟内RTT的末值、最小值、中位数、95分位和最大值，用于观察波动。: Last, minimum, median, 95th percentile and maximum RTT in the latest minute, to show variation.
当前原始包窗口中的缺失数与期望数，二者用于计算链路丢包率。: Missing and expected original packets in the current window, used to calculate network loss.
会话内收到的原始RTP包与在宽限期后认定缺失的原始包。: Original RTP packets received and original packets declared missing after the grace period during this session.
原始包乱序、重复、超宽限期迟到和无法解释序号跳变后的统计重置次数。: Original packet reorderings, duplicates, arrivals beyond the grace period, and statistic resets after unexplained sequence jumps.
当前还没有新鲜、可解释的原始包窗口；不会伪造零丢包。: No fresh, interpretable original packet window yet. Zero loss is not assumed.
进入接收管线的完整视频帧率。: Rate of complete video frames entering the receiver pipeline.
当前视图提交的新画面帧率；不是显示器扫描输出帧率。: Rate of new frames submitted by this viewport. This is not monitor scanout FPS.
主机报告的显示器模式刷新率，未知或旧主机显示缺省。: Monitor mode refresh rate reported by the host. Blank when unknown or using an older host.
当前视频尺寸与目标帧率；不会改变远端桌面模式。: Current video size and target frame rate. Does not change the remote desktop mode.
实际协商的编码与色彩模式，区别于请求偏好。: Actual negotiated codec and color mode, which can differ from the requested preference.
客户端当前实际使用的解码后端。: The decode backend currently used by the client.
近期接收到的视频码率；不是目标码率或总链路带宽。: Recently received video bitrate, rather than target bitrate or total link traffic.
主机发送视频包时等待传输API完成的时间，可能包含套接字背压和调度。: Time the host waits for video packet transport API calls, which can include socket backpressure and scheduling.
完整帧进入解码工作队列到开始解码的等待。: Wait from a complete frame entering the decode work queue until decoding starts.
解码画面发布到UI领取之间的等待；受UI唤醒、绘制预算和负载影响。: Wait between publishing a decoded frame and UI consumption; affected by UI wakeups, drawing budget and load.
发送、解码、邮箱等待的均值之和；缺样本时显示未知。: Sum of mean send, decode queue and mailbox waits. Unknown when a sample is missing.
FEC恢复的包数与收到的冗余包数，会话累计。: Packets recovered by FEC and redundancy packets received, accumulated for this session.
会话收到的FEC冗余数据量。: Total FEC redundancy bytes received in this session.
会话累计超时未恢复包。: Total packets not recovered before timeout in this session.
接收器丢弃的不完整或损坏视频帧。: Incomplete or damaged video frames discarded by the receiver.
解码后端返回的错误次数。: Errors returned by the decoder backend.
解码队列为保留新鲜画面而丢弃的帧数。: Frames discarded by the decode queue to keep the picture current.
修复接收器记录的乱序与迟到次数。: Reorderings and late packets recorded by the recovery receiver.
当前窗口、主机授权和本地输入归属共同决定是否能远程输入。: Remote input depends on the current window, host authorization and local input ownership.
客户端发送的输入消息数和发送错误数。: Input messages sent by the client and send errors.
输入在客户端的排队、确认往返、主机队列与系统注入耗时，单位毫秒；确认不代表画面响: Client input queue wait, acknowledgment round trip, host queue wait and OS injection time in milliseconds. An acknowledgment does not indicate a visible response.
分别由接收损坏、解码队列溢出、解码错误和格式改变触发的恢复次数。: Recoveries triggered by damaged input, decode queue overflow, decoding errors and format changes, respectively.
复制当前全部诊断数值。也可拖选单个数值后按Ctrl+C；点击画面恢复远程键盘。: Copy all current diagnostics. You can also select individual values and press Ctrl+C; click the video to restore remote keyboard input.

An ongoing gap counts once and remains for 60 seconds after completion. Focus loss, minimization, display changes or FPS changes reset the baseline. Source inactivity, missing frames, network, decode or UI scheduling may cause gaps; this does not identify the cause or measure physical display stutter. Fewer than two frames is unknown.

按同一源画面身份关联主机源呈现和客户端系统显示回执。四时间戳只约束时钟偏移区间，: Matches the host source presentation and client system display receipt for the same source image.
